data.text:
Emma, I’d support that package if all five explicitly agree: 12 tons each this month, and no more than 6 each next month if the stock is 80.

One caution: the fallback protects recovery, but it doesn’t erase the income tradeoff. If we take 12 now and then 6 at 80 or 10 at 100, our expected catch over those two months is 21 tons each, versus 20 from taking 10 each both months. That’s a modest gain, not a guarantee of better long-run income.

My commitment is conditional on unanimous agreement; otherwise, I’ll take 10 unless we settle on another whole-ton plan. Kate, are you willing to join, including the 6-ton fallback?
